content.stem: 哪些技术通常被用于帮助金融机构(FIs)在安全地与私营第三方实体共享客户信息的同时，遵守隐私和数据保护法规？(选择两项。)

options.A: 利用区块链确保共享数据交易的可追溯性和安全性
options.B: 数据加密以保护敏感信息免受未经授权的访问
options.C: 隐私增强技术(PETs)，以实现安全且符合隐私保护要求的数据共享
options.D: 人工智能(AI)用于自动化合规流程，例如数据匿名化和安全共享
options.E: 用于高效数据处理和管理的云存储解决方案

content.stem_en: Which technologies are commonly used to help financial institutions (FIs) navigate privacy and data protection regulations while securely sharing client information with private third-party entities? (Choose Two.)

options_en.A: Blockchain to ensure traceability and security in shared data transactions
options_en.B: Data encryption to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access
options_en.C: Privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) to enable secure and privacy-compliant data sharing
options_en.D: Artificial intelligence (AI) to automate compliance processes such as data anonymization and secure sharing
options_en.E: Cloud storage solutions for efficient data processing and management
